title: Calmo's Bazooka
description: This Plugin Adds a Bazooka for Elytra PvP, Lightweight!
body:
CalmoBazooka is a lightweight PvP plugin that adds a custom bazooka item to your Minecraft server. Players can use the bazooka to shoot powerful fireballs that deal a fixed amount of damage, making it perfect for balanced PvP gameplay where armor should not fully decide the fight.
The plugin is made for fast-paced servers like QuickBox, ElytraPvP, BoxPvP, and PvP arenas. It includes configurable cooldowns, custom sounds, actionbar feedback, hex color support, editable item name and lore, admin commands, and WorldGuard support to disable the bazooka in protected regions such as spawn or safe zones.
CalmoBazooka is simple to use, easy to configure, and designed to add a fun, clean, and premium-feeling combat feature to your server.
